name: Futari Journeys
description: Futari Journeys is a calm, bespoke travel planning WordPress theme designed for couples embarking on honeymoons, anniversaries, and slow escapes. Built around thoughtful question-led layouts, documentary photography frames, and an unhurried editorial rhythm, it presents routes, fixed fees, and planning steps with clarity. Each tailor-made journey begins with honest answers and personal guidance from the first consultation to the flight home.

fonts.role: display: headings, questions, wordmark, numerals (variable, Latin subset)
